title: coleus schizophyllus
intro: Coleus schizophyllus, commonly known as Coleus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and pain, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The therapeutic actions of Coleus schizophyllus include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Coleus schizophyllus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
